_about: Terms for the platform pages (hardware platforms, TileLang, deep_cluster). Owner: platform writer.

platform.short: The object in deepinfer/platform.py that holds the hardware choices: kernel folder, communication backend, FP8 scale-factor type, memory pinning.
platform.long: There is one Platform object per process. Code gets it as deepinfer.PLATFORM ({{cite deepinfer/__init__.py:53-64}}).

cuda.short: NVIDIA's programming model, compiler and runtime for its GPUs. PyTorch calls it through the torch.cuda module.

cann.short: Compute Architecture for Neural Networks. Huawei's software stack (driver, runtime, libraries) for Ascend NPUs. It has the same role as CUDA.
cann.long: The README asks for CANN 9.2 on Ascend ({{cite README.md:52}}).

torch-npu.short: Huawei's PyTorch plug-in for Ascend NPUs. It adds the torch.npu module and the HCCL backend to PyTorch.

nccl.short: NVIDIA Collective Communications Library. It moves tensors between NVIDIA GPUs (all-reduce, all-to-all and others). PyTorch calls it the "nccl" backend.

hccl.short: Huawei Collective Communication Library. It moves tensors between Ascend NPUs. torch_npu adds it to PyTorch as the "hccl" backend.

gloo.short: A torch.distributed backend that sends CPU tensors over the network. DeepInfer uses it for CPU-side groups and for the first start-up connection.

tilelang.short: A Python language for writing GPU and NPU kernels. DeepInfer keeps one folder of TileLang kernels for CUDA and one for Ascend.

kernel-factory.short: In DeepInfer, a function named ..._tl. You call it with fixed parameters (sizes or dtypes), and it returns a compiled TileLang kernel that you then call with tensors.

deepep.short: DeepSeek's communication library for MoE. Its dispatch step sends tokens to the devices of their experts. Its combine step brings the results back.

afd.short: Attention-FFN Disaggregation. A design that runs attention layers and FFN (expert) layers on different groups of devices. DeepInfer does not use it.

epd.short: A deployment that runs the vision encoder (E), prefill (P) and decode (D) as separate model instances. It is not included in this DeepInfer release.

pinned-memory.short: CPU memory that the operating system cannot move or swap out. The GPU or NPU can copy from it directly (DMA), so copies are faster.

scale-factor.short: A number that multiplies a block of low-precision values to give their real size. DeepInfer packs one-byte UE8M0 scale factors into int32 (NVIDIA, 4 per value) or int16 (Ascend, 2 per value).

import-hook.short: Code that changes what a Python import statement returns. DeepInfer's npu_ops package uses one to replace two vendor functions on Ascend.

visible-devices.short: The devices a process can use, set by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (NVIDIA) or ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES (Ascend). Device 0 is the first visible one.

sm.short: Streaming Multiprocessor: one compute unit inside an NVIDIA GPU. "SM100" names the NVIDIA Blackwell data-center GPUs. DeepInfer checks only that the compute capability is 10.x.
